name: DOF-RAG Evidence Evaluation v4

authoring.gold_granularity: document plus chunk plus quoted span

limitations: Pilot set: 42 questions are not enough for narrow confidence intervals.
Several source documents are deliberately reused to isolate task-type behavior.
Gold answers and legal interpretations should receive independent domain-expert adjudication before becoming release gates.
Cross-reference questions are resolvable from quoted or reproduced target provisions in the same DOF publication; future versions should add more cross-document citation resolution.
Monitoring questions are frozen to dates present in the corpus snapshot and are not live templates.
